components.note: 日 (sun) — marks sun, daylight and time, as in 明 bright, 晚 evening, 早 early; 晃 is bright, dazzling light, then shaking light, as in 晃动 sway.
光 (light) — sun 日 over light 光: dazzling brightness.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 沾 is getting wet or touching, as in 沾边.
占 (zhàn) — close sound: 沾 zhān. 占 also sounds out 站 zhàn and 粘 zhān.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 撕 is tearing with the hands.
斯 (sī) — same sound: 撕 sī. 斯 also sounds out 嘶 sī and 厮 sī.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wooden things, as in 树 tree, 林 woods, 桌 table; 桩 is a stake or post, as in 木桩; also a measure word for affairs.
庄 (zhuāng) — same sound: 桩 zhuāng. 庄 also sounds out 装 zhuāng.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 捉 is catching or grasping.
足 (zú) — loose sound hint (zhuō vs zú).
⺼ (flesh, from 肉) — marks body parts, as in 肚 belly, 脸 face, 腿 leg; 肺 is the lungs.
巿 (fú) — close sound: 肺 fèi. 巿 also sounds out 沛 pèi and 柿 shì.
酉 (wine jar) — marks liquor, fermenting and tastes, as in 酒 liquor, 醉 drunk, 酸 sour; 酱 is sauce or paste, fermented food, as in 酱油 soy sauce.
刂 (knife; 刀) — marks cutting, as in 别 separate, 刻 carve, 划 slice; 刷 is brushing or scraping, as in 刷牙 brush teeth.
酉 (wine jar) — marks liquor, fermenting and tastes, as in 酒 liquor, 醉 drunk, 酸 sour; 酸 is sour, as vinegar and wine turn.
夋 (qūn) — loose sound hint (suān); same part in 俊 jùn.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 扶 is steadying with a hand.
夫 (fū) — close sound: 扶 fú. 夫 also sounds out 肤 fū and 麸 fū.
山 (mountain) — marks hills and heights, as in 岛 island, 峰 peak; 崔 is lofty, a mountain; mostly seen as the surname 崔.
羽 (feather, wing) — marks wings and flight, as in 翅 wing, 翔 soar; 翘 is lifting up like wings, as in 翘起.
尧 (yáo) — close sound: 翘 qiáo. 尧 also sounds out 烧 shāo and 晓 xiǎo.
瓦 (tile) — a picture of interlocking roof tiles. As radical it marks pottery, as in 瓶 bottle, 瓷 porcelain.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 抹 is wiping or smearing.
末 (mò) — close sound: 抹 mā/mǒ. 末 also sounds out 沫 mò and 茉 mò.
鹿 (deer) — a picture of a deer with antlers and legs, as in 麒麟. Appears in 丽 and 麋 too.
艹 (grass, 草字头) — marks plants and herbs, as in 花 flower, 草 grass, 菜 vegetable; 菲 is fragrant and lush, as in 芳菲; also the Philippines, 菲律宾.
非 (fēi) — same sound: 菲 fēi. 非 also sounds out 啡 fēi and 匪 fěi.
田 (field) — a picture of a field divided into plots. Appears in 男 man (field + strength), 界 border, 留 stay.
⺼ (flesh, from 肉) — marks body parts, as in 肚 belly, 脸 face, 腿 leg; 腰 is the waist.
要 (yào) — close sound: 腰 yāo. 要 was originally a picture of a waist.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 泥 is mud or clay, wet earth.
尼 (ní) — same sound: 泥 ní. 尼 also sounds out 呢 ne and 妮 nī.
土 (earth) — marks soil and ground, as in 地 ground, 城 city wall, 坏 broken; 堵 is a wall, then blocking, as in 堵车 traffic jam.
者 (zhě) — close sound: 堵 dǔ. 者 also sounds out 赌 dǔ and 都 dōu.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 摘 is picking or plucking.
啇 (dí) — loose sound hint (zhāi); same part in 滴 dī and 敌 dí.
井 (well) — a picture of a well frame, a square curb around a shaft, as in 水井 water well.
死 (dead) — 毙 is dying or killing, as in 枪毙 shoot dead.
比 (bǐ) — loose sound hint (bì vs bǐ).
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 押 is holding something as security or in custody, as in 押金 deposit.
甲 (jiǎ) — loose sound hint (yā vs jiǎ).
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 叶 is a leaf (simplified from 葉); in the older sense xié it means to harmonise.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 嗑 is cracking seeds with the teeth, as in 嗑瓜子.
盍 (hé) — loose sound hint (kè vs hé).
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — marks feelings and mood, as in 怕 fear, 快 happy, 恨 hate; 恤 is feeling pity, as in 体恤 and 抚恤.
血 (xuè) — loose sound hint (xù vs xuè).
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 披 is draping over the shoulders, as in 披风.
皮 (pí) — close sound: 披 pī. 皮 also sounds out 被 bèi and 疲 pí.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 渣 is what is left after liquid is strained, as in 残渣.
查 (chá) — close sound: 渣 zhā. 查 also sounds out 楂 zhā.
正 (zhèng, straight) with 不 not: not straight, so crooked, as in 歪斜.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 喘 is panting, breathing hard.
耑 (zhuān) — loose sound hint (chuǎn); same part in 端 duān and 湍 tuān.
穴 (cave) — marks holes and hollows, as in 空 empty, 窗 window; 窝 is a nest or den.
呙 (guō) — loose sound hint (wō); same part in 锅 guō and 蜗 wō.
巾 (cloth) — marks cloth and hangings, as in 布 cloth, 帜; 幢 was a curtain or banner, and is now the measure word for buildings.
童 (tóng) — loose sound hint (chuáng vs tóng); 童 also sounds out 撞 zhuàng.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 呦 imitates a deer's bleat.
幼 (yòu) — close sound: 呦 yōu.
冫 (ice, 两点水) — marks cold and freezing, as in 冷 cold, 冰 ice, 决; 凉 is cool, as in 凉快 pleasantly cool.
京 (jīng) — loose sound hint (liáng vs jīng); same part in 凉 liáng and 谅 liàng.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 拽 is pulling or dragging, as in 拉拽.
曳 (yè) — same sound: 拽 yè (also zhuài). 曳 also sounds out 洩 xiè.
皿 (dish) — marks vessels and containers, as in 盒 box, 盘 plate, 盆 basin; 盐 is salt, once evaporated in dishes.
饣 (food; traditional 食) — marks food and eating, as in 饭 meal, 饿 hungry, 饺 dumpling; 饱 is full from eating.
包 (bāo) — close sound: 饱 bǎo. 包 also sounds out 抱 bào and 跑 pǎo.
舟 (boat) — marks boats, as in 船 ship, 航 sail; 舱 is a ship's cabin.
仓 (cāng) — same sound: 舱 cāng. 仓 also sounds out 苍 cāng and 沧 cāng.
页 (head, page) — marks the head, as in 顺, 领, 额 forehead; 颈 is the neck.
辶 (walk, 走之) — marks movement and roads, as in 过 pass, 进 enter, 送 send; 逛 is strolling around.
狂 (kuáng) — close sound: 逛 guàng. 狂 also sounds out 诳 kuáng.
冫 (ice, 两点水) — marks cold and freezing, as in 冷 cold, 冰 ice, 决; 冻 is freezing.
东 (dōng) — close sound: 冻 dòng. 东 also sounds out 栋 dòng and 动 dòng.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 咋 is a dialect question word, how or why.
乍 (zhà) — close sound: 咋 zǎ. 乍 also sounds out 诈 zhà and 炸 zhà.
